card.name: Sports scoring and game results
card.fires_on: Words in sports reports about scoring or game results, such as scored, late touchdown, goal, innings, and score lines like 6-5. It fires on the wording around a score, not on medical text.

modes.label: Scoring plays
modes.description: Verbs and nouns describing a team or player scoring or winning, such as scored, touchdown, or goal.
modes.example: Five years ago: The New York Giants<< scored>> a late touchdown to win Super Bowl XL

modes.label: Score lines and innings
modes.description: The hyphen or digits in a final score and the word inning in baseball game recaps.
modes.example: On July 3, he lost a 6<<->>5 fourteen-inning game.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward scoring and winning words such as scored, winning, decisive, and score.
card.plain: It marks sports game recaps where teams score points and win or lose by a given score.
